notes: Initial committed release snapshot for the converted HIPE-derived news-agency dataset that was used for the first Hugging Face dataset publication. Release JSONL files use the compact public Hugging Face projection with wikidata_url as the public entity link and optional ocr_correction for corrected OCR surfaces. Public entities omit synthetic entity IDs; stable references should use row id plus character offsets and label. Integer token label IDs are derived from token_labels and label_map.json when needed. Thesis-era news_agency_as_source provenance is kept in local/audit data and excluded from public rows. Full conversion audit/provenance files are kept locally under ignored audit.d/ and should be archived externally if long-term provenance is needed.
